requirement: Verify whether Firebase Authentication App Check enforcement applies to the Google credential-exchange path and whether the installed release app is aligned with that enforcement.
affectedLayer: Firebase Authentication App Check enforcement and Android attestation
evidence: The release app includes the Firebase App Check plugin.
The live Google identity stage succeeds but Firebase credential exchange rejects.
The Google-only forensic runtime explicitly does not activate App Check.
Read-only Firebase Console verification on 2026-08-23 reports Authentication App Check status Unenforced.
correctiveAction: Read back the Firebase Authentication App Check enforcement state and the registered Android provider; change configuration or implementation only if a mismatch is proven.
testPlan: Classify Authentication enforcement as enforced, monitoring, or off.
If enforced, prove a valid release App Check token is available before Google Firebase credential exchange.
If not applicable, record the console evidence and close without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Any proven mismatch is corrected and directly verified, or the ticket is closed PASS/NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence.
regressionRisk: Changing enforcement without evidence could weaken protection or block all production authentication.
exclusions: No production configuration mutation without a proven gap and explicit authorization.
No other Firebase product or provider changes.
